title: codec.rs: panic on short UDP packet (line 993)
description:
P1 SECURITY: In compress(), when nh==17 (UDP) and packet length is 40-47 bytes, line 993 slices `packet[48..]` unconditionally causing a panic. The length check at line 983 (`packet.len() >= 40 + 8`) only gates the MQTT-SN block; line 993 executes after that block regardless of length.

A malformed/truncated UDP packet causes index-out-of-bounds panic instead of falling back to rule 255 (uncompressed). This violates the function's documented fallback behavior and could be triggered by malformed network input.

Fix: Move line 993-1016 inside the length check block, or add explicit `if packet.len() < 48 { /* fallthrough */ }` before line 993.

Discovered by: 3x codereview (correctness, security, edge-cases passes)
File: rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs
Line: 993
close_reason: Fixed: moved UDP CoAP/OSCORE handling inside 'packet.len() >= 48' check. Short UDP packets now fall through to uncompressed fallback instead of panicking. cargo check and cargo test pass.
